summary: Iter32 - PERAN & HAK AKSES (Roles & Access) end-to-end testing. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASS on /api/access/modules (24 modules), /api/access/roles (11 builtin + custom incl. cr_staf_penagihan with locked/deletable/modified/levels {level,partial}), POST create custom role with base_role sales & levels {customer:manage, penjualan:view, rnd:none}; validations: label conflict->409, label too short->400, base_role=admin->400; PATCH custom role (label + inventory:view); PATCH admin->403; PATCH sales label->400; PATCH sales levels->modified=true then POST reset->modified=false; create user with cr_ role -> DELETE role while used ->409, after reassign->200 (id removed from GET); non-admin (sales) GET /api/access/roles ->403; login penagihan@ works (permissions dict populated). Frontend: ?view=entities-access -> entities-access-tab-roles -> role-access-panel visible with cr_staf_penagihan + admin (locked) cards. role-create-button opens role-editor-drawer; label 'TEST_Peran UI QA'; role-editor-copy-from=finance (KNSelect) works; role-level-customer-manage toggles; role-menu-preview visible; save->role-editor-confirm modal->confirm-save closes drawer with entities-access-flash visible and new card in role-custom-grid. Editing new card: role-level-penjualan-none produces role-module-changed-penjualan marker; save via confirm succeeds. Reopen->role-editor-delete active (not disabled)->handled window.confirm dialog->card removed. role-card-admin opens with role-editor-locked banner, role-editor-save disabled=True, level buttons disabled=True. Accounts tab present. Login penagihan@kainnusantara.id/demo12345 successful, sidebar renders (Meja Finance, PENJUALAN, PEMBELIAN, GUDANG, KEUANGAN, KAS & ASET, Profil Saya, Analitik) with no console errors and no crash.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleEditorDrawer uses window.confirm() for delete and reset actions; consider replacing with in-app modal for consistency with role-editor-confirm (impacts automated testing and mobile UX).

custom_role_service.delete_custom counts ALL users (including inactive/soft-deleted) via count_documents({'role': rid}); by design this is safe, but consider surfacing count of active vs inactive users in the 409 detail so admins know they must first reassign inactive accounts too.
seed_data_creation: During tests a transient custom role 'TEST_Peran Uji QA' (cr_test_peran_uji_qa) and 'TEST_Peran UI QA' (cr_test_peran_ui_qa) plus TEST_qauser_iter32_<uuid>@example.com users were created and cleaned up. Verified no residual TEST_ custom roles or TEST_ users. Sales role was PATCHed & RESET (final state modified=False as required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_access_roles_iter32.py (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from frontend/.env). Backend endpoints /api/access/* and roles registry all working. Frontend RoleEditorDrawer uses window.confirm() for delete and reset -> future Playwright tests must attach a `dialog` handler to auto-accept. Custom role cr_staf_penagihan is used by penagihan@ user and must not be deleted. Test cleanup path: PATCH user role via {"data":{"role":"sales"}} then DELETE /api/access/roles/{id}.
